text:
carla: quick postmortem follow-up — we need a compact plan to reduce blast radius and add an automated rollback scanner. short list: infra hard cap, rollback hysteresis, nightly scanner for correlated rollouts, sim harness.
ben: +1. i'll add router-level hard_cap (default 1%) and emit X-Rollout-Audit headers when caps hit. will return 429 for excess traffic.
tomas: i'll own the auto-rollback logic. proposed rule: require two signals (error_rate spike AND p95 increase) sustained for 90s, then trigger rollback -> stable. include exponential backoff for reopen (1m,5m,15m).
aya: i'll build a tiny sim that sweeps sample_rate, latency, and error-inject. output CSV with triggered_rules column so we can feed the nightly scanner. command sketch:
```
./tools/sim_rollout --sweep sample_rate,latency,error --seed 7 --out results/scan.csv
```
ops-bot: system: TASK-7203 created: rollout safety scanner assigned to aya.
carla: owners + deadlines: ben (router cap) PR by Mon 05/11; tomas (rollback engine) PR by Wed 05/13; aya (sim + nightly scanner) PR by Fri 05/15.
ben: console note: product wants a visible hard-cap indicator and an override button; overrides must require 2 approvers and write an audit reason.
tomas: ensure rollback switches traffic atomically and pages SRE. add tests that simulate rollback path.
aya: will wire sim outputs to the postmortem ticket automatically and add deterministic seeding for CI.
carla: also add a nightly job that scans recent rollouts for clusters (same timeframe, overlapping regions) so we catch correlated small rollouts.
ops-bot: reminder: staging dry-run scheduled 05/19 10:00 PDT.
carla: thanks — please post PRs here and tag blockers. we’ll review in eng-platform sync next week. :white_check_mark:
